NFL.note: Elo from real final scores: 1500 is average; +100 points is about a 64% favorite on a neutral field. Trend = rating change over the last 30 days.

matchups.note: Offense = points scored above an average team against an average defense; Defense = points kept off the board versus average. Both are adjusted for opponents and weight recent games more.

dvp.note: Allowed % = how much each position produces against this defense compared with what those same opponents normally produce at that position. + means the defense is soft there, - means it is tough.

roster.note: Rating 0-99 = rank against players at the same position this season (99 = best). Players without enough playing time, and offensive linemen, are not rated.
